events.name: US Fed (FOMC) rate decision
events.why: US interest-rate decision and press conference. Can move global markets, the dollar and foreign flows into India.
events.note: Meeting 27 to 28 Oct. The decision comes on the second day, which is late night in India.

events.name: US CPI inflation (October data)
events.why: US inflation reading. Shapes expectations for Fed rates and the dollar.
events.note: Date matches the US BLS schedule as published by two sources. Open the link to double-check.

events.name: India CPI inflation (October data)
events.why: India retail inflation. Key input for RBI rate expectations.
events.note: MoSPI says 12 Nov (Thursday) or the next working day.

events.name: RBI policy decision (MPC meeting 2 to 4 Dec)
events.why: RBI repo rate and stance decision. Directly affects banks, rate-sensitive sectors and bond yields.
events.note: RBI announced the meeting dates 2, 3 and 4 Dec. The decision usually comes on the last day.

events.name: US Fed (FOMC) rate decision with projections
events.time: 12:30 AM IST on 10 Dec (2:00 PM New York)
events.why: US rate decision plus the Fed's new economic projections.
events.note: Meeting 8 to 9 Dec. The date shown is the US date.

events.name: US CPI inflation (November data)
events.why: US inflation reading before the year-end.
events.note: Date matches the US BLS schedule as published by two sources. Open the link to double-check.

events.name: India CPI inflation (November data)
events.note: MoSPI calendar says 12 Dec, which is a Saturday. Release may move to the next working day, so check MoSPI.

events.name: RBI policy decision (MPC meeting 3 to 5 Feb)
events.why: RBI repo rate and stance decision, the last meeting of this financial year.
events.note: RBI announced the meeting dates 3, 4 and 5 Feb 2027. The decision usually comes on the last day.
